Harvest · The day's picking

Logging a harvest

One record for each day's picking: which plots, how many kilos, how ripe, how sweet. The first link between a plot and the coffee that leaves it.

Running through this pageFinding your way 1One coffee, one chain 3Kilos carry forward 3Quality as you go 2Nothing gets lost 1Records you can trust 4Guidance, not guarantee 1

Record the day

What it is

A harvest says what was picked, where and when. Later a process run takes its cherry from one or more harvests, and the green lot it makes points back through them to the plots. You need at least one plot first; if you have none yet, save the harvest now and tick its plots later.

Also inOne coffee, one chain

Step 1 · Record today's picking

Open Origin from the menu, then the Harvest tab. A line shows the season so far (harvests, kilos of cherry, average Brix), then your harvests, newest first.

Also inFinding your way

Step 2

Tap + Harvest. The Harvest code and Date are filled in. The code is made from the date: H, then year, month and day, then a number for the day (H261102-1 is the first harvest on 2 November 2026).

Try it in the app ›

Also inOne coffee, one chain

Step 3 · Say which plots were picked

Change the Date if you picked on another day (Start time and End time are optional). Under Plots picked, tick each plot. Choose the Picking (Selective, Strip, Gleaning or Mixed) and the number of Pickers.

Also inOne coffee, one chain

Step 4 · Weigh the baskets

Under Weights, tap + Add basket once for each basket, picker or batch. Put a name in the left box and the kilos in the box marked kg. The total adds up as you type: 3 · total 56 kg beside the button and Total cherry 56 kg from 3 baskets below.

Also inKilos carry forward

Watch out

A weight in the name box. If the kilos go into the left box, the app reads them as a name: the total does not grow and no Total cherry line appears. Look for the total after every row; if it is missing, move the number into the kg box.

Also inKilos carry forwardRecords you can trust

Tip

One row called Day total with the day's kilos works as well. Separate rows show who picked what, or help to pay by weight.

Also inKilos carry forward

Step 5 · Note ripeness and Brix

Under Cherry quality, fill what you know: Ripe %, Under-ripe %, Over-ripe %, Floaters %. For sweetness, tap + Add Brix reading once for each refractometer reading; Average Brix shows with the number of readings and their range.

Also inQuality as you go

Tip

Not sure what counts as ripe, or when to pick? The Crop care, harvest link under the weights opens the app's guide to what to pick, when and how, with its sources named.

Also inQuality as you goGuidance, not guarantee

Step 6

Add Weather, Notes, the people who worked (＋ Person) and photos (Take a photo or From gallery) if you like. Tap Save. Saved shows for a moment, and the harvest is at the top of the list with its kilos, picking, ripeness and Brix.

Also inNothing gets lost

When something was wrong

Step 7 · Correct a mistake

Tap the harvest to open it, change it, tap Save. At the bottom, Entered by… opens the record's history: who entered it, and each change with its date, who made it, the field and its old and new value.

Also inRecords you can trust

Step 8 · Remove a harvest entered twice

If a whole harvest should not be there, open it and tap Void. The app asks for a reason. A voided harvest leaves the lists but is kept, and Voided at the end of the list can restore it. Anything linked to it keeps its link.

Also inRecords you can trust

Why it matters

A buyer who trusts your records needs to know they were not quietly changed. The change kept beside the record, with who and when, is what makes it worth trusting.

Also inRecords you can trust
